extra_caveats: Value Investors Club's public page shows ideas only after 90 days (the page's end date was 2026-07-21). The 30 ideas published 2026-07-13 through 2026-07-20 are the ones that became public in this window. The form line that the author or people they advise hold a material investment in the issuer's securities counts as a long. Twelve US or Canada ideas under about US$10 billion that use that line were scored from the saved text. AirBoss of America and Sphere Entertainment use the line that they do not hold a material investment, so they stay dropped as author not long. Capral is listed in Australia.
